SELECT
DATE(create_time) as date, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) as value
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%u') as date, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) as value
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') as date, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) as value
DATE(create_time) as date, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) as value
FROM oms_order WHERE status != 4 AND create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY
DATE(create_time)
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%u')
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m')
DATE(create_time)
ORDER BY date

SELECT
DATE(create_time) as date, COUNT(*) as value
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%u') as date, COUNT(*) as value
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') as date, COUNT(*) as value
DATE(create_time) as date, COUNT(*) as value
FROM oms_order WHERE status != 4 AND create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY
DATE(create_time)
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%u')
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m')
DATE(create_time)
ORDER BY date
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM oms_order WHERE status != 4 AND create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oms_order WHERE status != 4 AND create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(return_amount), 0) FROM oms_order_return_apply WHERE status = 2 AND create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oms_order_return_apply WHERE status = 2 AND create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT CASE WHEN source_type = 0 THEN 'pc' WHEN source_type = 1 THEN 'app' WHEN source_type = 2 THEN 'wechat' ELSE 'others' END as channel, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) as amount FROM oms_order WHERE status != 4 AND create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY source_type

SELECT COALESCE(o.receiver_province, '未知') as region, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) as amount FROM oms_order o WHERE o.status != 4 AND o.create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY o.receiver_province ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT CASE WHEN pay_type = 1 THEN '支付宝' WHEN pay_type = 2 THEN '微信支付' WHEN pay_type = 3 THEN '银行卡' ELSE '其他' END as name, COUNT(*) as value FROM oms_order WHERE status != 4 AND pay_type IS NOT NULL AND pay_type != 0 AND create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY pay_type ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN '待发货' WHEN status = 1 THEN '待发货' WHEN status = 2 THEN '运输中' WHEN status = 3 THEN '已完成' WHEN status = 4 THEN '已取消' WHEN status = 5 THEN '退款中' ELSE '其他' END as name, COUNT(*) as value FROM oms_order WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN '待发货' WHEN status = 1 THEN '待发货' WHEN status = 2 THEN '运输中' WHEN status = 3 THEN '已完成' WHEN status = 4 THEN '已取消' WHEN status = 5 THEN '退款中' ELSE '其他' END
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM oms_order WHERE status != 4 AND create_time BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{startDate}, INTERVAL 1 YEAR) AND DATE_SUB(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oms_order WHERE status != 4 AND create_time BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{startDate}, INTERVAL 1 YEAR) AND DATE_SUB(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ums_member WHERE create_time <= #{endDate} AND (gender IS NOT NULL OR birthday IS NOT NULL OR city IS NOT NULL OR job IS NOT NULL)
SELECT CASE WHEN gender = 1 THEN '男' WHEN gender = 2 THEN '女' ELSE '未知' END as gender, COUNT(*) as count FROM ums_member WHERE create_time <= #{endDate} GROUP BY gender

SELECT CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birthday, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 18 AND 25 THEN '18-25岁' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birthday, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 26 AND 35 THEN '26-35岁' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birthday, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 36 AND 45 THEN '36-45岁' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birthday, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 46 AND 55 THEN '46-55岁' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birthday, CURDATE()) > 55 THEN '55岁以上' ELSE '未知' END as ageRange, COUNT(*) as count FROM ums_member WHERE create_time <= #{endDate} AND birthday IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birthday, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 18 AND 25 THEN '18-25岁' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birthday, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 26 AND 35 THEN '26-35岁' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birthday, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 36 AND 45 THEN '36-45岁' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birthday, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 46 AND 55 THEN '46-55岁' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birthday, CURDATE()) > 55 THEN '55岁以上' ELSE '未知' END ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT COALESCE(job, '未知') as occupation, COUNT(*) as count FROM ums_member WHERE create_time <= #{endDate} GROUP BY job ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT COALESCE(city, '未知') as region, COUNT(*) as count FROM ums_member WHERE create_time <= #{endDate} GROUP BY city ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT consumption_level as level, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) as count FROM ( SELECT member_id, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 500 THEN '低消费(0-500元)' WHEN COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) BETWEEN 500 AND 1500 THEN '中低消费(500-1500元)' WHEN COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) BETWEEN 1500 AND 3000 THEN '中等消费(1500-3000元)' WHEN COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) BETWEEN 3000 AND 8000 THEN '高消费(3000-8000元)' WHEN COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) > 8000 THEN '超高消费(8000元以上)' ELSE '未知消费' END as consumption_level FROM oms_order WHERE status != 4 AND create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY member_id ) consumption_data GROUP BY consumption_level ORDER BY CASE consumption_level WHEN '低消费(0-500元)' THEN 1 WHEN '中低消费(500-1500元)' THEN 2 WHEN '中等消费(1500-3000元)' THEN 3 WHEN '高消费(3000-8000元)' THEN 4 WHEN '超高消费(8000元以上)' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END

SELECT pc.name as tag, COUNT(DISTINCT oo.member_id) as count FROM oms_order oo JOIN oms_order_item ooi ON oo.id = ooi.order_id JOIN pms_product pp ON ooi.product_id = pp.id JOIN pms_product_category pc ON pp.product_category_id = pc.id WHERE oo.status != 4 AND oo.create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY pc.name ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT pc.name as category, COALESCE(SUM(ooi.real_amount), 0) as amount FROM oms_order oo JOIN oms_order_item ooi ON oo.id = ooi.order_id JOIN pms_product pp ON ooi.product_id = pp.id JOIN pms_product_category pc ON pp.product_category_id = pc.id WHERE oo.status != 4 AND oo.create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY pc.name ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT device_type as device, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) as count FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN login_type = 0 THEN 'PC端' WHEN login_type = 1 THEN '移动端' WHEN login_type = 2 THEN '移动端' WHEN login_type = 3 THEN '移动端' ELSE '其他' END as device_type, member_id FROM ums_member_login_log WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) device_data GROUP BY device_type ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT HOUR(create_time) as hour, COUNT(*) as count FROM ( SELECT create_time FROM ums_member_login_log WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} UNION ALL SELECT create_time FROM oms_order WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND status != 4 ) t GROUP BY HOUR(create_time) ORDER BY HOUR(create_time)
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(total_amount), 0) FROM oms_order WHERE status != 4 AND create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT member_id), 0) FROM oms_order WHERE status != 4 AND create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) as totalUsers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN order_count > 1 THEN member_id END) as repurchaseUsers FROM ( SELECT member_id, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM oms_order WHERE status != 4 AND create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY member_id ) t
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pms_product WHERE delete_status = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pms_product WHERE delete_status = 0 AND publish_status = 1

SELECT pc.id as categoryId, pc.name as categoryName, COALESCE(SUM(ooi.real_amount), 0) as salesAmount FROM pms_product_category pc LEFT JOIN pms_product pp ON pc.id = pp.product_category_id LEFT JOIN oms_order_item ooi ON pp.id = ooi.product_id LEFT JOIN oms_order oo ON ooi.order_id = oo.id WHERE oo.status != 4 AND oo.create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY pc.id, pc.name HAVING salesAmount > 0 ORDER BY salesAmount DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT pp.id as productId, pp.name as productName, COALESCE(SUM(ooi.real_amount), 0) as salesAmount, COALESCE(SUM(ooi.product_quantity), 0) as salesQuantity FROM pms_product pp JOIN oms_order_item ooi ON pp.id = ooi.product_id JOIN oms_order oo ON ooi.order_id = oo.id WHERE oo.status != 4 AND oo.create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY pp.id, pp.name ORDER BY salesAmount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT price_range as `range`, COUNT(*) as count FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN price BETWEEN 0 AND 100 THEN '0-100' WHEN price BETWEEN 100 AND 500 THEN '100-500' WHEN price BETWEEN 500 AND 1000 THEN '500-1000' WHEN price BETWEEN 1000 AND 3000 THEN '1000-3000' WHEN price > 3000 THEN '3000+' ELSE '未知' END as price_range FROM pms_product WHERE delete_status = 0 AND price IS NOT NULL ) price_data GROUP BY price_range ORDER BY CASE price_range WHEN '0-100' THEN 1 WHEN '100-500' THEN 2 WHEN '500-1000' THEN 3 WHEN '1000-3000' THEN 4 WHEN '3000+' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END

SELECT stock_range as `range`, COUNT(*) as count FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN stock BETWEEN 0 AND 10 THEN '0-10' WHEN stock BETWEEN 10 AND 50 THEN '10-50' WHEN stock BETWEEN 50 AND 100 THEN '50-100' WHEN stock BETWEEN 100 AND 500 THEN '100-500' WHEN stock > 500 THEN '500+' ELSE '未知' END as stock_range FROM pms_product WHERE delete_status = 0 AND stock IS NOT NULL ) stock_data GROUP BY stock_range ORDER BY CASE stock_range WHEN '0-10' THEN 1 WHEN '10-50' THEN 2 WHEN '50-100' THEN 3 WHEN '100-500' THEN 4 WHEN '500+' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END
